title: Man Utd's 2011 final XI
brief: Name the ten outfield players who started for Man Utd against Barcelona in the 2011 Champions League final (28 May 2011), when they lost 3-1. The goalkeeper (Edwin van der Sar) is left out.

notes.Nani: Nani came on as a substitute in the 2011 final, so he did not start.
notes.Paul Scholes: Paul Scholes came on as a substitute in the 2011 final, so he did not start.

checks: Starting XI, positions and shirt numbers from the team sheet on the final's Wikipedia page; the same eleven players and shirt numbers are on the Transfermarkt match report. Positions are Wikipedia's.
